optionDescriptions.getHTML: The document as HTML, in the editor's profile unless one is given.
optionDescriptions.getJSON: The document as the portable JSON shape.
optionDescriptions.getMarkdown: The document as Markdown; anything Markdown cannot express is downgraded.
optionDescriptions.getText: The document's text, with blocks joined by `blockSeparator`.
optionDescriptions.getPlainTextAlternative: The `text/plain` alternative for a multipart e-mail.
optionDescriptions.insertContent: Inserts content at the selection, or at `at`.
optionDescriptions.clear: Empties the document, optionally clearing the undo stack with it.
optionDescriptions.isEmpty:
True for `''`, `

`, `


` and whitespace-only content (fixes R2).
optionDescriptions.getLength: The document's length in `unit`, defaulting to the configured `countUnit`.
optionDescriptions.getSelection: Where the selection is, or `null` when the editor is not focused.
optionDescriptions.setSelection: Moves the selection, either to a range or to a named position.
optionDescriptions.saveSelection: Captures the selection so it survives focus moving to a popover.
optionDescriptions.restoreSelection: Puts back a selection captured by EditorInstance.saveSelection.
optionDescriptions.getFormatState: Every mark and block format at the selection.
optionDescriptions.focus: Focuses the content element, optionally placing the caret.
optionDescriptions.blur: Moves focus out of the content element.
optionDescriptions.hasFocus: True while the caret is inside the content element.
optionDescriptions.exec: Runs a command through its middleware chain; returns whether it did anything.
optionDescriptions.canExec: Whether the command could run right now, which is what disables a control.
optionDescriptions.isActive: Whether the command's effect is already applied, which is what presses a toggle.
optionDescriptions.registerCommand: Adds a handler to a command's middleware chain; returns its unregister function.
optionDescriptions.canUndo: Whether there is anything to undo.
optionDescriptions.canRedo: Whether there is anything to redo.
optionDescriptions.clearHistory: Drops the undo stack, so loaded content cannot be undone away.
optionDescriptions.insertLink: Links the selection, or inserts a new link when it is collapsed.
optionDescriptions.removeLink: Unwraps the link at the selection, leaving its text.
optionDescriptions.getLinkAtSelection: The link the caret is inside, or `null`.
optionDescriptions.insertImage: Inserts an image from attributes you already have.
optionDescriptions.uploadFiles: Runs files through the upload handler and inserts the results.
optionDescriptions.insertMergeTag: Inserts a merge tag as an atomic node (fixes R23).
optionDescriptions.getMergeTags: The keys of every merge tag currently in the document.
optionDescriptions.insertTable: Inserts a table and places the caret in its first cell.
optionDescriptions.setEditable: Turns editing on or off without changing the disabled or read-only props.
optionDescriptions.isEditable: Whether the content can currently be edited.
optionDescriptions.isFullscreen: Whether the editor is in fullscreen.
optionDescriptions.toggleSourceView: Opens or closes the HTML source view.
optionDescriptions.isSourceView: Whether the HTML source view is open.
optionDescriptions.find: Searches the document and selects the first match from the caret.
optionDescriptions.replace: Replaces every match in one undo step; returns how many were replaced.
optionDescriptions.clearDraft: Removes the autosaved draft, which is what a successful submit should do.
optionDescriptions.saveDraft: Writes an autosave draft now rather than waiting for the interval.
optionDescriptions.validate: Runs `required`, `maxLength` and the `validate` prop. Returns the message or `null`.
optionDescriptions.announce: Announce a message through the editor's polite live region.
optionDescriptions.on: Subscribes to one editor event; returns its unregister function.
optionDescriptions.getSnapshot: Current derived state; the same object `useEditorState` selects from.
optionDescriptions.id: Stable per-instance id, used to namespace DOM ids (fixes R4).
